name: DESIREON
source:
2012. All main antagonists of this world have been defeated, all major enemy organizations have been destroyed. Peace that everyone had waited for so long has reigned. But with no danger special forces that serve as a shield against any threats have become useless. Our protagonist, commander of Iron Hand District southern sector fell into depression. 
At this time on the city's outskirts, radar picked up an unknown spaceship... Perhaps this is a dangerous storm after a long pleasant calm.
translation:
2012年。这个世界的主要反派都已被击败，重要的敌对组织也全部覆灭。人们期盼已久的和平终于降临。然而，失去危险后，原本作为威胁屏障的特种部队也变得无用。我们的主人公是Iron Hand District南部辖区的指挥官，陷入了抑郁。
就在这时，城市郊区的雷达捕捉到一艘不明飞船……或许，这就是漫长而舒适的平静之后，一场危险风暴即将到来的征兆。
